metric_identity.RAFT: Original VBench dynamic-degree RAFT stride2, 41 sampled frames / 40 pairs / 20 iterations; pair score is mean of largest 5 percent pixel-flow magnitudes
metric_identity.RAFT_repeated_scores: 48 clipwise 40-score vectors exactly equal between continuous-only v2 and eight-axis v3; repeat computation is charged, not independent evidence
metric_identity.quality: Eight unmodified VBench/VBench-I2V metric functions, custom development cohort, raw per-video units (MUSIQ 0-100, others 0-1)
metric_identity.motion_semantics: RAFT responds to object, camera, texture and illumination; no subject-motion attribution from amplitude alone
metric_identity.checkpoint_accounting: Observed torch.load/jit.load/safetensors.load_file only; pre-import aliases, safe_open and opaque/native loaders UNKNOWN; non-RAFT internal forward counts UNKNOWN
